entries.what: Google OAuth's out-of-band (OOB) flow is blocked for every client in production, including exempted ones, and users see an error. Apps with the Testing publishing status can still use it.

source.quote: January 31, 2023 - all existing clients are blocked (including exempted clients)

lookFor: A Google OAuth redirect_uri of urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob, urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob:auto or oob. Other OAuth servers use the same values and aren't this.
entries.replacement: Depends on the client: the loopback IP address flow for desktop, the recommended SDKs for Android and iOS, the Chrome Identity API for Chrome apps, and the Google API client libraries for web.
requires: The user no longer pastes a code in: the app has to receive the redirect itself, so a desktop app runs a local listener on the loopback address.
